name: SaaS with integrations
summary: Relay, a team-notes app: workspaces on Clerk organizations, a Stripe trial and billing, Slack and Google Calendar connected by OAuth, live notes over Pusher, and Inngest jobs that send email through Resend.
runsOn: A TanStack Start app, a Hono API, an Inngest worker and the Inngest dev server, with Postgres in Docker
shows: Onboarding that makes one workspace, one Clerk organization, one Stripe customer and one trialing subscription, however Clerk and Stripe fail on the way (102 trials)
Time travel through a trial: Stripe's trial_will_end on day 11 and the first invoice on day 14 start Inngest jobs, and the app's status matches Stripe's
A note posted to Slack exactly once under Slack 429s, 5xx and lost answers, and seen live by a teammate in a second browser
`SAAS_BUG` switches that turn one safeguard off, so you can watch the matrix catch it
